description: Cross-language conformance record for the kit REST server (go/transport/api and the Go api service's middleware plane). Go is the authority. Tables: client_address, trusted_proxies, hosts, listener_hosts, origin, and openapi_cases (expected documents rendered by huma from a language-neutral model; regenerate with go test ./go/transport/api -run TestAPIContractOpenAPI -update-api-contract). `ports` records which behaviors each port has shipped; PENDING passes. Also websocket_topics, metrics, client_cert and idempotency tables.

projection.description: The command-tree projection under /v1/commands. Go runs the rows against api.MountCommandProjection with these descriptors and a stub executor; Rust projects the equivalent tree of a kit CLI root. A `run` command exits with its `exit` flag; every other command exits 0 and prints `ran <path>`. `call` is what the command saw (flag values as strings). `discovery` pins the listing; `openapi` pins the operations per invocable command. A gated command (`requires_confirmation`, and `requires_confirm_token` for a typed token) additionally accepts `confirm` and `confirm-token` from a caller, which reach the command's own gate; any other command rejects them as undeclared. The token and refusal rows need a real gate and are Rust-side tests.
